## 1- Prepare the KC-MEL only object in FsEpi + PmtHEE

```{r}
##> input new all cell object
load("R9_4.2_new_cleaned_seurat_0.7.Rdata") # new cleaned seurat obj
cleaned_seurat_0.7-> selected_obj # all cells

table(selected_obj$study)
  # FibHSE  FsEpi PmtHEE 
  #  2248  16388   4139 
```

```{r}
### choose only FsEpi and PmtHEE study
cell_id <- subset(selected_obj@meta.data, 
                  study %in% c("FsEpi", "PmtHEE")) # 20527 cells

## extract the cells along the defined ID 
selected_study <- subset(selected_obj, cells=row.names(cell_id))
```

-   select only KC and MEL in FsEpi and PmtHEE

```{r}
## keep only KC and MEL cells
table(selected_study$cell_type_0.7)
    ## BAS-I  BAS-II BAS-III  BAS-IV   BAS-V    Endo   GRN-I  GRN-II GRN-III      HF      LC     MEL   SPN-I 
    ## 769     492    1503    1560    2067     114    1100    2119    1174      74     111     987    3025 
    ## SPN-II SPN-III  SPN-IV 
    #   650    1820    2962

# select all KC and MEL cells
cell_id <- subset(selected_study@meta.data, 
                  !cell_type_0.7 %in% c("HF", "LC","Endo")) # 20228 cells

## extract the cells along the defined ID 
selected_study_cells <- subset(selected_study, cells=row.names(cell_id))

# check again the cells
table(selected_study_cells$cell_type_0.7)
    #   BAS-I  BAS-II BAS-III  BAS-IV   BAS-V   GRN-I  GRN-II GRN-III     MEL   SPN-I  SPN-II SPN-III  SPN-IV 
    # 769     492    1503    1560    2067    1100    2119    1174     987    3025     650    1820    2962 
```

```{r}
## add the KC states for KCs
selected_study_cells-> selected_obj
#> get the cluster number "as character"
cluster_number = names(table(selected_obj$cell_type_0.7))
cluster_number = cluster_number[1:13]
    ##>  [1] "BAS-I"   "BAS-II"  "BAS-III" "BAS-IV"  "BAS-V"   "GRN-I"   "GRN-II"  "GRN-III" "MEL"     "SPN-I"  
    ##>  [11] "SPN-II"  "SPN-III" "SPN-IV"

  #> make corresponding cluster annotation.
annotation_cluster = c(
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"GRN",
"GRN",
"GRN",
"MEL",
"SPN",
"SPN",
"SPN",
"SPN")

# make the corresponding annotation table with cell_cluster
cluster_anno = data.frame(cluster_number, annotation_cluster, stringsAsFactors = F)

# add empty column for meta.data
selected_obj@meta.data$KC_states = "NA"

# fill the cell types by cluster number comparison
for(i in 1:nrow(cluster_anno)) { 
selected_obj@meta.data[which(selected_obj@meta.data$cell_type_0.7 == cluster_anno$cluster_number[i]),'KC_states'] <- cluster_anno$annotation_cluster[i] 
  }

#> check the result and performance
table(selected_obj$KC_states)
    # BAS  GRN  MEL  SPN 
    # 6391 4393  987 8457 
```

### [save] KC and MEL in FsEpi and PmtHEE

```{r}
selected_obj-> selected_study_cells
save(selected_study_cells,file = "R10_1_kc_mel_in_Epi_and_PmtHEE.Rdata")
```

## 2- Cellchat obj from Seurat

```{r}
load("R10_1_kc_mel_in_Epi_and_PmtHEE.Rdata")
selected_study_cells-> selected_obj
```

```{r}
## split the obj to FsEpi and PmtHEE
split_list <- SplitObject(selected_obj, split.by = "study")
```

### 2.1- cellchat_PmtHEE

```{r}
split_list$PmtHEE-> pmthee # define the seurat obj

data.input <- pmthee[["RNA"]]@data # normalized data matrix
# For Seurat version >= “5.0.0”, get the normalized data via `seurat_object[["RNA"]]$data`

Idents(pmthee) <- 'cell_type_0.7'
labels <- Idents(pmthee)
meta <- data.frame(labels = labels, 
                   row.names = names(labels)) 

cellchat_PmtHEE <- createCellChat(object = data.input, 
                                  meta = meta,
                                  group.by = "labels")
```

### 2.2- cellchat_FsEpi

```{r}
split_list$FsEpi-> fsepi

data.input <- fsepi[["RNA"]]@data # normalized data matrix
# For Seurat version >= “5.0.0”, get the normalized data via `seurat_object[["RNA"]]$data`

Idents(fsepi) <- 'cell_type_0.7'
labels <- Idents(fsepi)
meta <- data.frame(labels = labels, 
                   row.names = names(labels)) 

cellchat_FsEpi <- createCellChat(object = data.input, 
                                  meta = meta,
                                  group.by = "labels")
```

### [save] cellchat-original

```{r}
save(cellchat_PmtHEE,cellchat_FsEpi,file = "R10_2_cellchat_obj_no_processed.Rdata")
```

## 3- Define the RL interaction database

```{r}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human # use CellChatDB.mouse if running on mouse data

# check you database CellChatDB.human
pdf("R10_3_database_check.pdf", width=10, height=5)
par(mfrow = c(2,3), # plot layout to a 2row x3 col grid
    xpd=TRUE, # allowed outside the plot region
    cex.main=1) # title magnification

showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)

dev.off()
```

![](images/Screenshot%202025-03-26%20at%2010.12.10%E2%80%AFPM.png){width="391"}

```{r}
# # use all CellChatDB for cell-cell communication analysis
# CellChatDB.use <- CellChatDB

# 
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling", key = "annotation") # secrete autocrine/paracrine signaling interactions
```

## 4- Process the cellchat obj

### 4.1- For cellchat_PmtHEE

```{r}
cellchat_PmtHEE-> cellchat

# set the used database in the object
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
future::plan("multisession", workers = 4) # do parallel
## overexpression check
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean") 
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 0)

cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat) # LR pair number
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
mat <- cellchat@net$weight # the probability list
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP") 
```

```{r}
library(NMF)
library(ggalluvial)

## pattern analysis for outgoing
selectK(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing") # if error, just re-run it.
nPatterns =  6 # Need input
cellchat <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing", k = nPatterns)

selectK(cellchat, pattern = "incoming")
nPatterns = 2 # need input
cellchat <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat, pattern = "incoming", k = nPatterns)
```

### [Save]

```{r}
cellchat-> cellchat_PmtHEE
save(cellchat_PmtHEE, file = "R10_cellchat_PmtHEE_processed_for_visualize.Rdata")
```

### 4.2- For cellchat_FsEpi

```{r}
cellchat_FsEpi-> cellchat

# set the used database in the object
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database

# Increase memory limit before parallelization
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4000 * 1024^2)  # 4 GB

future::plan("multisession", workers = 4) # do parallel
## overexpression check
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)

cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean") 
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 0)

cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat) # LR pair number
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
mat <- cellchat@net$weight # the probability list
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP") 
```

```{r}
library(NMF)
library(ggalluvial)

## pattern analysis for outgoing
selectK(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing") # if error, just re-run it.
nPatterns =  8 # Need input
cellchat <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing", k = nPatterns)

selectK(cellchat, pattern = "incoming")
nPatterns = 7 # need input
cellchat <- identifyCommunicationPatterns(cellchat, pattern = "incoming", k = nPatterns)
```

### [Save]

```{r}
cellchat-> cellchat_FsEpi
save(cellchat_FsEpi, file = "R10_cellchat_FsEpi_processed_for_visualize.Rdata")
```

### 4.3- Merge cellchat obj

```{r}
# Combine two processed cellchat object
object.list <- list(FsEpi = cellchat_FsEpi, 
                    PmtHEE = cellchat_PmtHEE)

cellchat <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
cellchat # 610 signaling genes ; 20228 cells. 
```

### [save]

```{r}
# Users can now export the merged CellChat object and the list of the two separate objects for later use
save(cellchat, file = "R10_4.3_cellchat_merged_processed_PmtHEE_FsEpi_cells_KC_MEL.RData")
# load("R10_4.3_cellchat_merged_processed_PmtHEE_FsEpi_cells_KC_MEL.RData")

save(object.list, file = "R10_4.3_cellchat_list_processed_PmtHEE_FsEpi_cells_KC_MEL.Rdata")
# load("R10_4.3_cellchat_list_processed_PmtHEE_FsEpi_cells_KC_MEL.Rdata")
```

### 5.2- Merged group for CCC number

```{r}
### merge the cell states and check the general plot

## check the cell types
  unique(cellchat@idents$joint)
  #> [1] BAS-IV  BAS-III BAS-I   MEL     
  #> [5] SPN-II  SPN-IV  BAS-V   SPN-I   
  #> [9] BAS-II  SPN-III GRN-II  GRN-I  
  #> [13] GRN-III

## check the celltyps order
  levels(cellchat@idents$joint)
  #> [1] BAS-IV  BAS-III BAS-I   MEL     
  #> [5] SPN-II  SPN-IV  BAS-V   SPN-I   
  #> [9] BAS-II  SPN-III GRN-II  GRN-I  
  #> [13] GRN-III
  #> 
group.cellType <- c(rep("BAS", 3),"MEL",
                    rep("SPN", 2),"BAS","SPN","BAS","SPN",
                    rep("GRN", 3))

group.cellType <- factor(group.cellType, 
                         levels = c("BAS", "SPN", "GRN","MEL"))

object.list <- lapply(object.list, function(x) {mergeInteractions(x, group.cellType)})

cellchat_2 <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
```

```{r}
weight.max <- getMaxWeight(object.list, slot.name = c("idents", "net", "net"), attribute = c("idents","count", "count.merged"))

pdf("R10_5.2_diff_CCC_merged_cell_types.pdf", width=10, height=5)
par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
for (i in 1:length(object.list)) {
  netVisual_circle(object.list[[i]]@net$count.merged, weight.scale = T, label.edge= T, edge.weight.max = weight.max[3], edge.width.max = 12, title.name = paste0("Number of interactions - ", names(object.list)[i]))
}
dev.off()
```

### 5.3- Pathway diff

```{r}
pdf("R10_5.3_CCC_merged_cell_types_diff.pdf", width=10, height=5)
num.link <- sapply(object.list, function(x) {rowSums(x@net$count) + colSums(x@net$count)-diag(x@net$count)})
weight.MinMax <- c(min(num.link), max(num.link)) # control the dot size in the different datasets
gg <- list()
for (i in 1:length(object.list)) {
  gg[[i]] <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_scatter(object.list[[i]], title = names(object.list)[i], weight.MinMax = weight.MinMax)
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(plots = gg)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

### 5.4- Single obj check

```{r}

## plot for FsEpi
object.list$FsEpi-> cellchat

mat <- cellchat@net$weight # the probability list

pdf("R10_5.4_LR_weight_for_each_cell_type_plot.pdf", width=11, height=9)
par(mfrow = c(3,4), xpd=TRUE)

# plot, [sum probability of ALL LRs for each cell type]
#> net -> LRs
#> netP -> Pathways 
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)) # cell number for each
for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])
}

dev.off()
```
